summary: OIO Group (formerly ESGL Holdings) filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of Nasdaq approval for its business combination with De Tomaso Automobili Holdings Limited, expected to close on or about April 24, 2026. The combined company will list on Nasdaq under ticker OIO. A 1-for-3 reverse stock split will occur immediately prior to closing to meet Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement (Rule 5550(a)(2)). The filing includes unaudited pro forma condensed combined financial information. This is a de-SPAC transaction where OIO (the SPAC target/shell) acquires De Tomaso, with all conditions including regulatory approvals expected to be satisfied before closing. Watch for any last-minute regulatory or Nasdaq condition waivers and the combined entity's opening trading price.
